name: gate_whitespace_reformatted_quote
about: The model quotes the line with its spacing collapsed. The quote check ignores whitespace, so an honest quote must not be rejected for an invisible difference.
diff:
diff --git a/cart.py b/cart.py
--- a/cart.py
+++ b/cart.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def line_total(price, quantity, discount):
     total = price * quantity
-    return total * (1 - discount)
+    return total - discount

findings.title: Discount is now subtracted as a flat amount
